headline: A clip of Meta chief executive Mark Zuckerberg appearing to wince over a pint of Guinness on a podcast drew online jokes.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: a widely shared moment involving AI leaders, with no consequence.
importance_line: It changes nothing for anyone and is a light moment built on social-media jokes about a facial expression, which nobody has confirmed reflects what the two men felt.
summary: Business Insider reports that a clip of Meta chief executive Mark Zuckerberg appearing to wince after a sip of Guinness on the podcast "Cheeky Pint", hosted by John Collison, cofounder of the payments company Stripe, drew online jokes, with commentator Ed Zitron joking that he should have spat it out. In the same 134-minute episode Zuckerberg and Meta executive Alexandr Wang discussed Meta's new Muse personal AI agent, and Meta did not immediately comment on what they thought of the drink.
notes: Read from fulltext. Episode date not stated in the article.
